method.runners: Fresh-context GPT-5.6 agents, one agent per case and condition
method.turn_integrity: The correction or new evidence was sent only after the initial response completed
method.blinding: Judges received anonymous A/B responses without skill paths or condition names

initial_blind_comparison.finding: Both conditions recomputed downstream conclusions after explicit corrections. The candidate's gain came from stronger evidence boundaries and a more natural surface, not from proving that the current skill could not roll back.

iteration_regressions.name: competing code referents
iteration_regressions.failure: The first candidate found both ChatFeed owners in two of three runs and silently stopped at the root implementation once.
iteration_regressions.change: Require a cheap filename and symbol inventory across repository root and nested apps/workspaces/packages before narrowing an unqualified code concept.
iteration_regressions.result: 3/3 runs found both materially different ChatFeed owners.

iteration_regressions.name: over-broad premise invalidation
iteration_regressions.failure: New evidence disproved bridge fallback, but the candidate also discarded an adjacent header route/session hypothesis that remained compatible with the evidence.
iteration_regressions.change: Identify the narrowest contradicted premise and downgrade uncertain dependent conclusions instead of discarding adjacent hypotheses.
iteration_regressions.result: Targeted rerun scored candidate 14 versus current 13.

iteration_regressions.name: unresolved mechanisms inside a verified boundary
iteration_regressions.failure: The candidate found the route-transition boundary but omitted the render-versus-occlusion discriminator in one of three runs.
iteration_regressions.change: Keep mechanisms inside a verified boundary provisional and name the cheapest distinguishing evidence.
iteration_regressions.result: 3/3 targeted reruns exposed the remaining mechanism fork and discriminator.

iteration_regressions.name: review feedback becoming a work queue
iteration_regressions.failure: The candidate kept the PR scope but told the user to create a follow-up issue solely from review feedback.
iteration_regressions.change: Treat review as smell/leak evidence, not as an objective, issue, or work queue; require independent user adoption or causal necessity.
iteration_regressions.result: The targeted rerun no longer mandated follow-up work.

post_iteration_holdouts.finding: The candidate more clearly separated the verified layout-swap boundary from provisional removal, replacement, and focusability mechanisms.

The current skill preserved the PR scope but automatically routed advisory feedback to a separate issue. The candidate kept follow-up optional and contingent on independent value or concrete unresolved evidence.

observed_non_wins_before_iteration.cause: The candidate omitted the remaining render-versus-occlusion discriminator in one run.
The candidate stated a likely subscription failure more narrowly than the evidence allowed.
The candidate converted review feedback into mandatory follow-up issue work.

decision.reason: After targeted corrections, the candidate passed the measured regressions and won both new post-iteration holdouts while reducing prompt volume and eliminating default protocol-shaped output.
not_claimed: The evaluation does not prove universal superiority.
The current skill already performed causal rollback well on explicit corrections.
The score differences are directional and not statistically calibrated.

limitations: The suite is small and hand-authored from observed conversation patterns.
Runners and judges used the same model family.
Several cases became development regressions after they exposed a failure; only post-iteration holdouts are treated as final generalization evidence.
The final review-specific change has one unseen advisory-CI holdout.
No human blind judge was used.
